What to look for: `Func` is an empty `inout` function -- its body never touches
its parameter. `PSMain` pre-decrements `i` exactly once and passes that as
Func's argument: `Func(--i)`. A correct compile therefore subtracts one input
unit from the loaded value before storing it to the output. Compare the
operand of the arithmetic instruction generated for the `--i` expression (near
the DXIL disassembly's `StoreOutput`/`bufferStore` call) across the dxc panes:
it currently subtracts two input units, not one -- the pre-decrement is
applied twice. This does not depend on optimisation level or shader stage; it
reproduces identically in the pixel-shader source tested locally and in the
compute-shader restatement shown here.
